data.summary: Muster Verlag GmbH sent a first reminder (1. Mahnung) for the annual subscription to "Muster Magazin" (subscription period 1 June 2025 – 31 May 2026). €59.40 is outstanding plus a €2.50 reminder fee, totalling €61.90, due by 30 June 2025.
data.explanation: This is a payment reminder from a magazine publisher, not a court order. It says the annual subscription fee of €59.40 plus a €2.50 late fee (total €61.90) was still unpaid and asks for payment by the stated date. If you already paid, the letter says to disregard it. If you haven't paid and don't believe you owe it, you should contact the publisher directly to clarify, since no legal remedy procedure is listed here. If left unpaid, further reminders or collection steps could follow, though none are stated in this letter.
